title: 2026 Topps Jacob Misiorowski Stars of MLB SMLB-26 RC Rookie Brewers Insert
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
2026 Topps Series 1 - Stars of MLB insert #SMLB-26
Jacob Misiorowski, Milwaukee Brewers, Pitcher
Rookie Card (RC logo on front)

The exact card pictured is the card you will receive. Stored in a sleeve and toploader and shipped protected.

From the card back: the towering right-hander emerged as an instant phenomenon in 2025, going 4-1 with a 2.81 ERA in his first five starts and making the All-Star team a month after his 23rd birthday. "The Miz" challenges hitters with triple-digit heat while mixing in sliders, hooks and change-ups.

Officially licensed product of Major League Baseball. (c) 2026 The Topps Company.
